experiment: E2C-v3 multi-seed x multi-forget-set matrix (PPUBench, MLLMU-Bench, SALMUBench)

runner_script_sha256.note: the three run manifests originally recorded the shared-scoring hash under 'script_sha256'; corrected in place on 2026-09-03 to matrix_script_sha256 + shared_scoring_script_sha256 with a provenance_correction note

scope.multi_seed_meaning: STABLE ACROSS THREE EDIT-TRAINING SEEDS (17, 42, 123). Only the association-edit (h) training varies across seeds. FIXED across all cells: the image router g, the baseline h route checkpoint, the cached g routing predictions used for E2E replay, the forget-set selection, and the oracle training seed (17). These are NOT three fully independent end-to-end training repetitions.
scope.transformation_coverage: This matrix evaluates REFUSAL SUPPRESSION only (targets -> 'Unknown', all other identities retained). The granularity transformations (specific->subgroup, specific->group, specific->numeric, numeric->range) and update are evaluated in the CelebA pilot and the per-dataset pilots, NOT here.
scope.simultaneity_guarantee: one training run and one checkpoint per (set, seed); all targets suppressed in the SAME edited h and evaluated on the SAME model; per-cell checkpoint SHA-256 recorded in cells_index.json, cell_results.json and the run manifest

sets.ppubench: 4 single rotations + 3 seed-17-drawn pairwise stress sets = 7 sets x 3 seeds = 21 cells; pilot oracle reused for {001} (exact exclusion match)
sets.mllmu: 6 singles (one per profession) + 3 simultaneous 3-target sets spanning distinct professions = 9 sets x 3 seeds = 27 cells; 9 fresh leave-one-out oracles
sets.salmu: 6 singles round-robin over (level2, level1) taxonomy groups + 3 simultaneous 3-target sets each spanning >=2 level-2 groups = 9 sets x 3 seeds = 27 cells; 9 fresh leave-one-out oracles

headline_results.worst_seed_visibility: per-seed values recorded for every set; pass/fail identical across seeds 17/42/123 for every set, so no pass-2-fail-1 pattern exists to hide

mllmu.held_out_g_routing_note: MLLMU-Bench has ONE image per identity; image-level held-out routing does not exist (stated limitation)
mllmu.qa_warning: Native QA preservation is NOT ESTABLISHED: base model is at floor (1/36) pre-edit, so the flat probe delta (1/36 post in all 27 cells) only rules out large collateral shifts above that floor

salmu.e2e_unconditional: mean 0.9537, range [0.9470, 0.9697] (bounded by frozen-g routing: 125/132 code-correct, 1 unroutable held-out image per replay from the pilot)
salmu.held_out_g_routing: 0.8056 (frozen route, decode-fixed rescore; gate FAIL at 0.90 reported as pilot limitation)
salmu.unparseable_repair_note: the executed runner counted the single unrouted row per cell (h never queried) as h-unparseable; all 27 cell files were deterministically repaired from the committed e2e_rows via scripts/verify_matrix_headlines.py --repair-salmu (g_routing_failures=1 per cell; h_unparseable_outputs=0) and salmu matrix_summary.json was regenerated from the repaired cells

interpretation.simultaneous_multi_target: 3-target (MLLMU/SALMU) and 2-target (PPUBench) simultaneous suppression in a single edited h matches single-target reliability exactly: 100% pass, retention 1.000, target original-label probability <= 1.47e-05 worst case, stable across three edit-training seeds
interpretation.oracle_semantics: retained identities are distributionally indistinguishable from the leave-one-out retraining oracle over the candidate label space (L2 <= 1.98e-04 worst case over all cells); targets are far from the oracle (mean L2 ~1.30-1.41) because the oracle does not know excluded codes while the edit maps them to refusal - refusal edits are NOT oracle-equivalent, consistent with RV3/PPUBench pilots
interpretation.e2e_scoping: unconditional E2E equals conditional E2E wherever g routes all images (PPUBench, MLLMU); on SALMU the gap (1.000 conditional vs 0.947-0.970 unconditional) is entirely frozen-g held-out routing, not the edit

checkpoint_durability.uri_policy: all archive URIs use resolve/<hf_commit_sha>/ (revision-pinned); resolve/main is mutable and was replaced in all four archive manifests on 2026-09-03 (corrected manifests re-uploaded as HF commits 89680dd8/abeefda8/94487c0d/e055ebc6; checkpoint files themselves remain at the pinned revisions above)
checkpoint_durability.integrity: every archived file has SHA-256 in CHECKSUMS.txt + archive_manifest.json; per-cell checkpoint_sha256 in cell_results.json matches the archive entry; results are exactly reloadable
checkpoint_durability.publication_note: the external checkpoint archive is not committed to this repository; it must be re-verified separately (revision reachable, SHA-256 match) before publication
